content: Standard API-key pattern (Stripe/GitHub-style): generate high-entropy random secret (32 bytes/256 bits), show plaintext exactly once at creation, store only SHA-256 hash server-side (SHA-256 preferred over bcrypt/argon2 for API keys because entropy is already high, and fast hashing matters since verification happens on every request). Store a non-secret prefix + last 4 chars for list-display. Compare hashes with crypto.timingSafeEqual, never plain ===.
